🚨 CVE-2026-132779 - Nginx
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Nginx
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 5.3
Resumo:
When NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source is configured to use TLS 1.3 early data using the ssl_early_data on directive, an attacker can use a specially crafted TLS 1.3 connection to drive an NGINX worker into a tight loop in which it repeatedly retries the same send without ever making progress. The worker continues accepting new connections and handling existing ones, but one CPU core is pinned at 100%. Impact: System p...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-132779
 
🚨 CVE-2026-60078 - Grafana
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Grafana
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
Allocation of resources without limits or throttling vulnerability in Apache IoTDB. Authenticated Grafana clients can bypass row-limit cap to trigger heap-exhaustion DoS. This issue affects Apache IoTDB: from 0.13.0 through 2.0.11. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.0.12, which fixes the issue.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-60078

🚨 Hackers Exploit N-able MailAssure Flaw While AI Agents Exploit MONAI Label Zero-Day
 
Criticidade: Crítica
Ferramenta: Qualys
Fonte: The Hacker News
CVSS: 9.3
Resumo:
Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Monday added two flaws impacting N-able MailAssure and MONAI Label to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, citing evidence of active exploitation. The critical vulnerabilities are listed below - CVE-2026-134624 (CVSS score: 9.3) - A server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in N-able MailAssure's LDAP
Link: https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/hackers-exploit-n-able-mailassure-flaw.html
 
🚨 VMware vCenter Hit by Another Critical 9.8-Rated Auth Bypass Flaw After Zero-Day Exploitation
 
Criticidade: Crítica
Ferramenta: Qualys
Fonte: The Hacker News
CVSS: 9.8
Resumo:
Broadcom has shipped patches to address 23 vulnerabilities impacting VMware ESX, vCenter, Workstation, Fusion, and Avi Load Balancer, including one critical bug that could be abused to bypass authentication. The critical vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-123903, is rated 9.8 out of 10.0 on the CVSS scoring system. It resides in the VMware Directory Service ("vmdir").
Link: https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/vmware-vcenter-hit-by-another-critical.html
 
🚨 CVE-2026-134836 - Check Point
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Check Point
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 8.1
Resumo:
Dashy 4.0.0 before 4.9.12 contains a credential disclosure vulnerability in isLocalRequest that attaches user credentials to lookalike hosts due to prefix-only origin checks. Attackers can lure logged-in users to a crafted ?config= link pointing to a lookalike host, capturing bearer tokens or HTTP auth headers to read configuration and stored API keys, or modify them when the victim is an admin.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-134836
 
🚨 Google Researcher Shows How a Single Bit Change in .NET Files Bypassed Windows Code Integrity
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Qualys
Fonte: The Hacker News
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
A quirk in how the .NET Framework loads a program file let a local attacker run untrusted code past two separate protections on Windows built to block it, Google Project Zero researcher James Forshaw showed in a write-up published yesterday. The same loading behavior bypassed Oracle VirtualBox's process hardening on Windows hosts, tracked as CVE-2026-87268, and Windows code integrity, tracked
Link: https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/google-researcher-shows-how-single-bit.html

Criticidade: Alta

Fonte: BleepingComputer
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
OpenAI and Cisco launched an open-source Linux security tool named Shirudo that deploys temporary runtime protections to block vulnerability exploitation while administrators prepare and roll out patches, without restarting services.
Link: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/new-shirudo-tool-uses-ai-to-shield-unpatched-linux-systems-from-exploits/

A local attacker with hypervisor access could possibly use this to trigger an out-of-bounds condition and compromise the integrity of SEV-SNP guest memory. (CVE-2023-20585) Several security issues were discovered in the Linux kernel. An attacker could possibly use these to c...
